artifact.body:
# [synthetic] voice answer for the interview

[synthetic] Answering a morning question by speaking should land in the same place typing does, with no separate path.

## What is settled

A single page per week, generated overnight, grouped by subject rather than by the day a note was captured.

## What is not

Whether a note spanning two subjects is duplicated or assigned to one. Raised as a question rather than decided here.
